capabilities: Preview .pptx, .docx, and .xlsx files in Obsidian tabs
Convert documents to PDF with headless LibreOffice
Auto-refresh the preview when the file changes on disk, including edits by AI agents
Navigate a custom PDF viewer with zoom, rotation, sheet tabs, and a thumbnail rail
Install LibreOffice from the plugin's settings
extras: Desktop Obsidian only; each conversion spins up a fresh LibreOffice process taking ~15-20s, so refreshes are not instant. The README details several rendering limitations, such as no detection of purely visual edits and single-page Excel sheet exports requiring LibreOffice 24.8+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in viewer for Office documents, so opening .pptx/.docx/.xlsx files means leaving the app for the OS default application.

relations.evidence: The file is converted to PDF with soffice --headless --convert-to pdf.
The PDF is rendered with pdf.js onto a <canvas>
including edits made by an external tool or an AI agent (e.g. Claude Code CLI

summary: Document previewer that opens PowerPoint, Word, and Excel files in Obsidian tabs, rendering them via a headless LibreOffice install.
